lines: Johnson missed Wednesday's practice with hamstring and wrist injuries, and the coach said his Week 12 availability is in question. Our projection gives him a 15% chance to play.
Over his last 3 games he played 53% of snaps and saw 2.0 targets per game, down from 61% and 4.3 on the season.
He has scored 5.4 PPR points per game over the last 3 games, compared with 8.4 for the season. Our Week 12 projection is 4.7.
